h1: Custom Golf Tees & Accessories for Branded Giveaways
metaTitle: Custom Golf Tees & Promotional Golf Items | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom golf tees and branded golf accessories for your next event. Perfect for corporate outings, tournaments, and client gifts. Shop now!
introHtml:
Marketing directors and business owners planning golf tournaments or corporate outings know that the right giveaway can set the tone for the entire event. Custom golf tees and accessories are a practical choice that players actually use, keeping your brand on the course from the first drive to the final putt. Whether you need personalized tees for a charity tournament, branded towels for a sales meeting, or logo umbrellas for a rainy day on the links, this category offers versatile options that appeal to golfers of all skill levels.

From bulk custom golf tees in value packs to premium golf kits and tools, Perfect Imprints carries a range of products that fit different budgets and quantities. Items like the Golf Buddy, Golf Ball Caddy, and Golf Tool Keyholder make great pocket-sized giveaways, while larger items like golf towels and umbrellas offer more surface area for your logo. All products can be decorated with your brand using screen printing, pad printing, or embroidery, ensuring a professional look that stands out on the course.
buyingGuideHtml:
When ordering custom golf tees and accessories, focus on product quality and decoration options. Golf tees are often made from hardwood or plastic, with hardwood being more eco-friendly and durable for repeated use. For accessories like towels and umbrellas, look for moisture-wicking fabric and sturdy frames. A well-made product reflects positively on your brand, so avoid cheap materials that may break or fade after one use.

Common Use Cases & Buyer Personas

Corporate tournament organizers often choose bulk custom golf tees and logo-printed golf balls as player gifts. HR directors may use branded golf accessories for employee appreciation events or team-building outings. Small business owners can use promotional golf items as client thank-you gifts or sales incentives. Each use case benefits from matching the product to the audience: value packs for large tournaments, premium kits for VIP clients.

Decoration & Customization Options

Most golf tees can be screen printed or pad printed with your logo. Towels and umbrellas offer more space for full-color heat transfer or embroidery. The Rugged 7-in-1 Golf Tool and Golf Tool Keyholder are ideal for laser engraving, giving a sleek, permanent mark. When choosing decoration, consider the product material and surface area. Small items like tees work best with one-color logos, while towels can handle multi-color designs.

Quantity Guidance & MOQ Context

Bulk custom golf tees typically have low minimum order quantities (MOQs), often starting at 500 pieces for value packs. For accessories like umbrellas or golf kits, MOQs may be higher, around 50 to 100 units. Ordering in larger quantities reduces per-unit cost, making it cost-effective for events with many attendees. If you need a small run for a client gift, consider personalized golf tees in smaller packs.

Wholesale custom golf tees are available through Perfect Imprints, with pricing that scales with volume. A typical bulk run for a corporate tournament might include 1,000 tees plus 200 towels. Plan ahead to ensure production time fits your event schedule, especially if you choose embroidery or full-color printing, which may add lead time.

Avoid common mistakes like ordering tees that are too short for standard use (2 1/8" is standard) or choosing a decoration method that doesn't adhere well to the material. For example, screen printing on curved surfaces like golf balls requires special equipment. Always request a proof before production to confirm logo placement and colors.
buyingGuideH2: Custom Golf Tees & Accessories Buying Guide

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for custom golf tees?
faqs.a: Minimum order quantities vary by product. For value pack golf tees, MOQs typically start at 500 pieces. For accessories like towels or umbrellas, MOQs may be around 50 to 100 units. Contact us for specific product MOQs.

faqs.q: What decoration methods work best for golf tees?
faqs.a: Screen printing and pad printing are the most common for golf tees. These methods work well on the small surface area and provide a durable imprint. For larger items like towels, embroidery or heat transfer are better options.

faqs.q: How long does production take for custom golf items?
faqs.a: Standard production typically takes 7-10 business days after art approval. Rush orders may be available for an additional fee. Complex decorations like embroidery may add a few days to the timeline.

faqs.q: Can I get a sample before placing a bulk order?
faqs.a: Yes, samples are available for most products. You can order a single sample with or without your logo to check quality and fit. Sample costs are usually deducted from the final bulk order.

faqs.q: What size golf tees are standard for promotional use?
faqs.a: The standard length for promotional golf tees is 2 1/8 inches, suitable for most drivers and fairway woods. Some suppliers offer longer tees for oversized drivers, but 2 1/8" is the most common for giveaways.
